contact.basis: Dry Warrington Plaza pavement outside the north vestibule street wall and projecting entrance canopy; not inner hall roof, water or gangway.

attribution: USGS3D Elevation Program, NJ_NE6County_B23; US government public domain
method: Unmodified1m USGS bare-earth Float32 GeoTIFF, locked raster48017 NJ_NE6County_B23(acquisition2023-04-13..2025-04-09), sampled bilinearly at pixel centers after WGS84/UTM18N projection. No flattening, offset fitting or building-derived ground. Five-metre local review grid; retained source tile and native Terrarium baseline.
limitations: Under-building ground is interpolated by source product, not a surveyed building threshold.
Coastal water surface/hydroflattening is not seabed or tide measurement; pile embedment remains unverified.
Source acquisition/current paving may differ from2010/2015 photo era; host terrain compatibility remains dataset-dependent.
